# netbox_prefix (Resource)

Manages a NetBox prefix (`/api/ipam/prefixes/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
resource "netbox_prefix" "example" {
  prefix      = "10.123.0.0/24"
  description = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `prefix` (String) Prefix.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `is_pool` (Boolean) All IP addresses within this prefix are considered usable. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `mark_utilized` (Boolean) Treat as fully utilized. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `role_id` (Number) ID of the Ipam Role (`netbox_ipam_role`).
- `scope_id` (Number) Scope Id.
- `scope_type` (String) Scope Type.
- `status` (String) Operational status of this prefix. Valid values: `container`, `active`, `reserved`, `deprecated`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `vlan_id` (Number) ID of the Vlan (`netbox_vlan`).
- `vrf_id` (Number) ID of the Vrf (`netbox_vrf`).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Created.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
# netbox_prefix can be imported by its NetBox object ID.
terraform import netbox_prefix.example 123
```
